# IndeXOS

> IndeXOS is a custom, Linux-based modular mobile operating system ecosystem built by J.B.

## Ecosystem Features
- **IndeXOS**: Core operating system layer and user interface.
- **IndeX Phone**: Custom hardware target running native .exe binaries and .hui layout files.
- **CoolDock**: Active thermal management and expansion dock.
- **Halet**: Portable companion ecosystem interface.
- **TV Dock**: Desktop display output dock.

## Official Repository
- GitHub: https://github.com/Halo-EAP/index-os-preview
